critique.evidence: Measured performance is demo-ready across all three viewports: LCP is 1700 ms desktop, 1644 ms tablet, and 516 ms mobile; FCP is 116/164/68 ms; CLS is 0.00046/0.04778/0; and document width exactly matches each viewport, showing no horizontal overflow. All 17 requests complete without console, page, or request failures. Animation stability is strong on tablet/mobile with 0 long-frame ratio, while desktop has a low 1.22% long-frame ratio and 50 ms worst frame. The main limitation is transfer cost: 1.30 MB total, including 1.14 MB of JavaScript, plus a slower 22.36 ms desktop average frame.
critique.fix: Reduce and code-split the 1.14 MB JavaScript payload, defer code not needed by the precedent screen, and profile desktop rendering to bring average frame time below 16.7 ms while preserving the already-low CLS and sub-1.7-second LCP.
